stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Can my prices use the repair?

stations.title: main.cpp
stations.text: The class, where no other file can see it.

stations.title: Every .cpp file
stations.text: Includes repair.h and gets the same class.

captions: Ambrose wants his prices to use the repair class too.
The class is written in main.cpp, which no other file can include.
You move the class into a header and the bodies of its functions into repair.cpp.
Now any file can include repair.h and use the same class.
The class has files of its own. Next, a bench that keeps a whole list of repairs.
